spec_match.rationale: Drives the exact WICG surface — navigator.rtc.startDiagnosticLogging() resolving a UUID session ID, finishDiagnosticLogging() finalising, cancelDiagnosticLogging() discarding — and correctly notes the page only ever receives the ID while logs stay in the browser.

interactive.rationale: Three real-call buttons gated by state-machine validity (finish/cancel enabled only while logging), a visual three-state machine, a live session-ID readout, and a timestamped call log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the three-state machine with real calls, a UUID appearing, and validity-gated buttons; all delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles the absent navigator.rtc with an honest flag note, disabled controls and no fake IDs, and surfaces real rejections with name/message on every call; button states prevent invalid-order calls.

references.rationale: See-also links siblings only — no https://chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376 self-heal link on this page (the capability-policy-probe sibling has it; this one and bug-report-companion do not).

conformance.rationale: The suite's navigator-rtc binding and three method typeofs are exactly this page's dependency; the 6 failures in this unflagged Chromium 141 are the expected absent experimental surface.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): initial DOM shows the honest warn status, visible flag note, disabled finish/cancel and idle state active; zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; the start/finish/cancel flow could not be driven non-interactively.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the UUID-returning start contract, finish and cancel resolutions, and start failures with error names.

design_system.rationale: Tokenised colours and active-state styling that flips background and color together, but the default-visible warn status (--accent-amber on --bg-stone, ~3.5:1 at 0.8rem bold) misses WCAG AA 4.5:1.

accessibility.rationale: role=status aria-live status line, role=log aria-live call log, aria-live session ID, the decorative state machine is aria-hidden with its state mirrored in text, and buttons expose disabled semantics.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow with the state chips and button row wrapping; desktop 1280×800 clean; only the environmental Google Fonts request fails.

openQuestions.title: Add the chromestatus feature link to this page's see-also
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3 requires the chromestatus.com/feature/5091582546149376 self-heal link on every page; this page and bug-report-companion link siblings only while capability-policy-probe carries it. One-line additive fix.

openQuestions.title: Fix the warn status amber contrast
openQuestions.detail: The default-visible 'navigator.rtc is not available' status renders --accent-amber on --bg-stone at ~3.5:1, under the AA 4.5:1 bar for 0.8rem bold text — the same shared pattern flagged across this milestone; a darker amber token fixes all instances.

openQuestions.title: Record the flagged start → finish/cancel state machine with a real UUID
openQuestions.detail: In Chrome 150+ with --enable-blink-features=RTCDiagnosticLogging, run start (capturing the UUID and the logging state flip), then finish and separately cancel, recording the log lines — this also exercises the suite's currently-failing method assertions positively.

summary: A precise state-machine demo of the diagnostic-logging lifecycle with validity-gated real calls, an honest absent-API fallback, and good live-region coverage. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): honest warn state with correctly-disabled controls, clean console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on either device class. Open items: per-page chromestatus link, the shared amber contrast fix, and flagged-browser lifecycle evidence.
